environment.description: Container running proxy_relay.py as a sidecar in a Kubernetes pod. The container uses a standard python:3.11-slim image with default securityContext. The upstream backend is a gunicorn/Flask app that prioritizes Transfer-Encoding over Content-Length per RFC 7230. Network policy allows any pod in the namespace to reach port 8080. No service mesh or L7 proxy sits in front of this relay.
